evidence.title: Morphing Search · React motion component · beUI

name: Morphing Search
summary: Search field that morphs into a glass results surface, with keyboard shortcut and icon-only trigger, for React.
description: A React and Next.js search trigger: a field or compact icon that morphs into a glass results panel when clicked or opened by keyboard shortcut. Props cover items, placeholder, shortcut, iconOnly, emptyMessage and controlled or uncontrolled open and query state; the panel lists items with a keyboard-driven row cursor. Install with the shadcn CLI (shadcn add @beui/morphing-search) or copy the source; needs the shared use-on-open and use-row-cursor hooks and the util files.
contains: search field or compact icon that morphs into a glass results surface
opens by click or keyboard shortcut; icon-only trigger variant
props: items, placeholder, shortcut, iconOnly, emptyMessage, open, query, onSelect
install: bunx --bun shadcn add @beui/morphing-search, or copy the source
shared files: lib/ease.ts, lib/utils.ts, hooks use-on-open and use-row-cursor
